retrievalProfile.description: A centered medium-shot portrait of a male artist in rugged attire against a desaturated, hazy outdoor background with a horizontal typographic band across the midsection.
triggerTerms: sepia outdoor portrait with text overlay
excludeWhen: urban or indoor settings are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a smiling man in a brown work shirt and jeans, positioned centrally against a soft-focus, sepia-toned landscape. A single line of sans-serif typography spans the width of the image, intersecting the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography bisecting the subject at the waist/chest level
Monochromatic sepia background contrasting with the subject's blue denim
Soft-focus background depth vs sharp subject detail
coreInvariants: Horizontal text placement across the subject's midsection
Warm, desaturated color palette with a sepia bias
Medium-shot framing from the waist up

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the horizontal text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the horizontal text line, then follow the arms to the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and background to allow the subject and text to stand out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and beige tones in the background and shirt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo blue in the denim jeans.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White or light cream highlights in the typography and watch face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark shirt and the light, hazy background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a weathered, earthy color profile

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both title and artist name to maintain a cohesive, modern look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, and clean geometric structure.
Provides the industrial, clean-cut look typical of modern country branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-shot portrait of a man in a brown work shirt and blue jeans, smiling, standing in a hazy, sepia-toned outdoor field. Ensure the background is soft-focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a single line of bold, condensed sans-serif text in all-caps across the center of the image, using wide tracking and a light cream color.

verificationChecks: Is the background desaturated and sepia-toned?
Is the font a bold, condensed sans-serif?
Does the text overlap the subject's torso?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the subject's face is in sharp focus.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the background.
Confirm the typography is in all-caps.
recipe.reuseFormula: Medium-shot portrait + centered horizontal condensed sans-serif + sepia-toned outdoor background.
